title: dalbergia brownei
intro: Dalbergia brownei, commonly known as the Philippine Rosewood, is a type of tree species belonging to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Dalbergia brownei include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
